actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The aarakocra attacks twice with its Wind Staff, and it may also use Spellcasting to cast Gust of Wind.

actions.name: Wind Staff
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The aarakocra can cast one of these spells without Material components, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At Will: Elementalism, Gust of Wind, Mage Hand, Message
1/Day: Lightning Bolt

spellcasting.name: Feather Fall (1/Day)
spellcasting.text:
The aarakocra reacts to the trigger of Feather Fall by casting it, with the same ability it uses for Spellcasting.
1/Day: Feather Fall

actions.name: Talons
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage. If the aarakocra covered at least 30 feet in a straight line toward the target right before the hit, the hit deals 9 (3d4 + 2) Slashing damage instead.

actions.name: Wind Javelin
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Thunder damage. Whether a ranged attack hits or misses, the javelin flies back to the aarakocra's hand at once, by magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The cultist makes two Tentacle Lash attacks, and it can swap any of them for a use of Mind Rot.

actions.name: Tentacle Lash
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. A target of Large size or smaller gains the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), held by one of two tentacles, and also gains the Restrained condition, which lasts until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Mind Rot
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, a single creature within 90 feet that the cultist can see. Failure: 27 (6d8) Psychic damage, and the target gains the Poisoned condition until the cultist's next turn starts. Success: Half damage, with no other effect.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The cultist can cast one of these spells, relying on Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At Will: Detect Thoughts, Minor Illusion

spellcasting.name: Counterspell (2/Day)
spellcasting.text:
The cultist responds to the trigger of Counterspell by casting it, drawing on the ability used for Spellcasting.
2/Day: Counterspell

traits.name: Fear of Fire
traits.text: Taking Fire damage imposes Disadvantage on the yeti's attack rolls and ability checks, lasting until its next turn ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The yeti uses Chilling Gaze and makes two attacks, each of which is a Claw or Ice Throw attack of its choice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Ice Throw
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 12 (2d4 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Chilling Gaze
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, a creature within 30 feet that the yeti can see. Failure: 21 (6d6) Cold damage, and the target gains the Paralyzed condition until the yeti's next turn starts, unless it has Immunity to Cold damage. Success: For 1 hour, the target can't be affected by this yeti's Chilling Gaze.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, every creature inside a 30-foot Cone. Failure: Each target takes 45 (10d8) Cold damage. Success: The damage is halved.

traits.name: Animal Lordship
traits.text: Each animal lord stands for a Forager, a Hunter, or a Sage, chosen by the DM, and that choice settles several traits in this stat block.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.text: When the animal lord fails a save, it may opt to succeed instead.

traits.name: Lordly Presence
traits.text:
Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy that begins its turn within a 30-foot Emanation that originates from the animal lord. Failure: One effect applies to the target, depending on the lord's type:
• Captivated (Forager Only) The target gains the Charmed condition, lasting until its next turn ends. It also has the Incapacitated condition for as long as it is Charmed.
• Fearful (Hunter Only) The Frightened condition is applied to the target until its next turn ends.
• Mired (Sage Only) 10 (3d6) Psychic damage is dealt to the target, which is also magically bewildered until its next turn ends. While bewildered, each of its saving throws takes a penalty of 1d4.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The animal lord has Advantage on any save against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The animal lord attacks twice, each attack being either Rend or Radiant Ray, and also uses Animal Spirit.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

actions.name: Radiant Ray
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 120 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Animal Spirit
actions.text:
The animal lord summons a spirit animal that lunges at a creature and then vanishes. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature within 120 feet that the animal lord can see. Failure: 28 (4d10 + 6) Radiant damage. Success: Half as much damage. Failure or Success: One effect applies, depending on the lord's type:
• Fortify (Forager Only) The animal lord receives 20 Temporary Hit Points for itself.
• Marked as Prey (Hunter Only) Until its next turn begins, the animal lord has Advantage on its attack rolls against the target.
• Pesky Swarm (Sage Only) The target's attack rolls and ability checks are made with Disadvantage until its next turn ends.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.text: The animal lord changes shape, becoming either a Huge or smaller form of the animal it embodies or a Small or Medium Humanoid, or reverting to its true form. Apart from size, its game statistics don't change between forms. Worn and carried equipment is not transformed.

legendary.name: Feral Strike
legendary.text: Moving up to its Speed, the animal lord avoids provoking Opportunity Attacks, then makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: Radiant Strike
legendary.text: The animal lord makes a single Radiant Ray attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The animal lord can cast one of these spells without Material components, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
At Will: Animal Friendship, Animal Messenger, Speak with Animals
2/Day Each: Awaken, Greater Restoration
1/Day Each: Animal Shapes, Sunburst

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: Flying out of an enemy's reach does not provoke Opportunity Attacks against the broom.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: Should the arcanaloth die anywhere other than Gehenna, its body melts into ichor and a fresh body forms immediately in Gehenna, where it returns to life with full Hit Points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The arcanaloth has Advantage on any save against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Tome
traits.text:
The arcanaloth owns a magical tome, and it can use its Banishing Claw action only while the tome is in its hands or on its person.
The tome has AC 17 and HP 35, with Immunity to Psychic, Poison, and Necrotic damage. At the end of each turn it recovers all of its Hit Points, but it crumbles to dust if it drops to 0 Hit Points or if the arcanaloth dies. After the tome is destroyed, the arcanaloth makes a new one upon finishing a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The arcanaloth makes three Fiendish Burst attacks, and one of them can be swapped for a Banishing Claw attack.

actions.name: Fiendish Burst
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Banishing Claw (Requires Soul Tome)
actions.text:
Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) Psychic damage. A creature that is hit also faces the effect below. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target is imprisoned in a demiplane within the Soul Tome and has the Incapacitated condition for as long as it stays there. It repeats the save when each of its turns ends and leaves the tome on a success, appearing in the space it left, or in the closest unoccupied space if that one is taken.
A target that fails three of these saves during its imprisonment becomes bound to the tome and can get out only if the tome drops to 0 Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.text: The arcanaloth teleports itself as far as 30 feet, to a vacant space that it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The arcanaloth can cast one of these spells without Material components, with Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At Will: Alter Self, Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation
1/Day Each: Contact Other Plane, Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Mind Blank

spellcasting.name: Counterspell
spellcasting.text:
The arcanaloth responds to the trigger of Counterspell by casting it, drawing on the ability used for Spellcasting.
At Will: Counterspell

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.text: A failed save by the hag can be turned into a success at its choice.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The hag has Advantage on any save against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Spiteful Escape
traits.text: The hag is killed by dropping to 0 Hit Points only when it is no more than 30 feet from its anathema, which is something the DM picks as the thing the hag hates most. If not, it instead stays at 1 Hit Point and teleports into a harmless demiplane, unable to come back to its original plane for 2d6 days. As it teleports away, every creature within 60 feet of where it was becomes cursed. For the duration of the curse, the creature makes ability checks and saving throws with Disadvantage, and the hag knows where it is anywhere in the multiverse.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hag uses Crackling Wave and makes two Spectral Claw attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Claw
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) Force damage. A target of Large size or smaller gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: Crackling Wave
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 22, every creature inside a 60-foot Cone. Failure: The target takes 32 (5d12) Lightning damage. Success: The damage is halved. Failure or Success: Until the hag's next turn ends, the target is cursed and can't take Reactions.

bonusActions.name: Witch Strike
bonusActions.text: Every creature within 60 feet of the hag that it has cursed takes 14 (4d6) Lightning damage.

legendary.name: Hag's Swipe
legendary.text: The hag makes a single Spectral Claw attack.

legendary.name: Malicious Magic
legendary.text: The hag uses Spellcasting to cast either Dimension Door or Hypnotic Pattern. This action can't be taken by the hag again before the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
spellcasting.text:
When at least two hag allies are within 30 feet of it, the hag can cast any one of the spells listed below. No Material components are needed, the normal casting time applies, and Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19). Once the hag casts a given spell this way, it must complete a Long Rest before it can do so with that spell again.
1/Long Rest: Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, Unseen Servant

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The hag can cast one of these spells without Material components, with Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):
At Will: Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Dispel Magic, Hypnotic Pattern
2/Day Each: Mass Suggestion, Modify Memory, Plane Shift

spellcasting.name: Tongue Twister
spellcasting.text:
The hag reacts to the trigger of Counterspell by casting that spell, using its Spellcasting ability. A target that fails its save is cursed until its next turn ends; for the curse's duration it can't cast spells that have a Verbal component, and whatever it says comes out as the opposite of its intent.
At Will: Counterspell

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The archpriest attacks three times with Radiant Burst.

actions.name: Radiant Burst
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Holy Word (Recharge 4–6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, each enemy inside a 20-foot Emanation centered on the archpriest. Failure: The target takes 21 (6d6) Radiant damage and gains the Stunned condition until the archpriest's next turn ends. Success: Half damage, with no other effect.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The archpriest can cast one of these spells without Material components, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At Will: Light, Thaumaturgy
1/Day Each: Flame Strike (level 6 version), Greater Restoration, Raise Dead, Zone of Truth

spellcasting.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
spellcasting.text:
The priest casts one of Healing Word, Bless, Lesser Restoration, or Dispel Magic, drawing on the ability used for Spellcasting.
3/Day: Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, Lesser Restoration

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: When each of the azer's turns ends, every creature the azer chooses within a 5-foot Emanation that originates from it takes 11 (2d10) Fire damage, though this doesn't happen if the azer has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The azer emits Bright Light out to 10 feet and Dim Light for another 10 feet beyond that.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The azer attacks twice using Flame Burst.

actions.name: Flame Burst
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The azer can cast one of these spells without Material components, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At Will: Elementalism, Mage Hand
1/Day: Fireball

spellcasting.name: Hellish Rebuke (2/Day)
spellcasting.text:
The azer responds to the trigger of Hellish Rebuke by casting it, drawing on the ability used for Spellcasting.
2/Day: Hellish Rebuke

traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: When an effect lets the bandit make a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, the bandit takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. This trait doesn't work while the bandit has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bandit makes three attacks, each with either Scimitar or Pistol.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

bonusActions.name: Deadly Aim
bonusActions.text: The bandit grants itself Advantage on its next attack roll this turn, and that attack deals an extra 28 (8d6) Poison damage to the target if it hits.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bandit attacks three times with its Dagger.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Blinding Flash (Recharge 4–6)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature inside a 10-foot-radius Sphere whose center is a point within 120 feet that the bandit can see. Failure: The target takes 13 (3d6 + 3) Radiant damage and gains the Blinded condition until the bandit's next turn starts. Success: Half damage, with no other effect.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The bandit can cast one of these spells, relying on Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At Will: Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion
1/Day Each: Hold Person (level 4 version), Mage Armor (included in AC), Major Image

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.text: By magic, the banshee knows which way to find any creatures within 1 mile that are neither Constructs nor Undead.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The banshee is able to pass through creatures and objects, treating them as Difficult Terrain. If its turn ends while it is inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The banshee uses Horrify and makes two Corrupting Touch attacks.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horrify
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 60 feet of the banshee, where each of the two can see the other. Failure: The target gains the Frightened condition until the banshee's next turn starts. Success: For 24 hours the target is immune to Horrify from this banshee.

actions.name: Deathly Wail (1/Day)
actions.text: Provided it isn't in sunlight, the banshee lets out a sorrowful wail. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature within 30 feet that hears the wail and is neither a Construct nor an Undead. Failure: A target with 25 Hit Points or fewer drops to 0 Hit Points; any other target takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: Should the barlgura die somewhere other than the Abyss, its body turns to ichor and it immediately takes a new one, returning to life with full Hit Points at some location in the Abyss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The barlgura makes two Thrash attacks and one Tormenting Bite attack.

actions.name: Tormenting Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. A target of Large size or smaller gains the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Leap
bonusActions.text: The barlgura leaps as far as 40 feet, at a cost of 10 feet of its movement.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The barlgura can cast one of these spells without Material components, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
2/Day Each: Disguise Self, Invisibility (self only)
1/Day Each: Entangle, Phantasmal Killer (level 6 version)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: The beholder may decide that a save it has failed is a success instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The beholder uses its Eye Rays action three times.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.text:
The beholder shoots one of the magical rays below at random, aimed at a target within 120 feet of itself that it can see (roll 1d10, rerolling any result for a ray already used earlier in this turn):
• 1: Charm Ray Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage and gains the Charmed condition, which lasts 1 hour but ends early if the target takes damage. Success: Half as much damage, and nothing more.
• 2: Paralyzing Ray Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target gains the Paralyzed condition. When each of its turns ends, it repeats the save, and a success ends the effect on it. After 1 minute, the target passes the save without rolling.
• 3: Fear Ray Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and gains the Frightened condition until its next turn ends. Success: Half damage, with no other effect.
• 4: Slowing Ray Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. Through the end of its next turn, the target has its Speed halved, can't take Reactions, and on its turn can use an action or a Bonus Action but not both. Success: Half damage, with no other effect.
• 5: Enervation Ray Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target takes 13 (3d8) Poison damage and gains the Poisoned condition until its next turn ends. The target can't regain Hit Points while Poisoned. Success: Half damage, with no other effect.
• 6: Telekinetic Ray Strength Saving Throw: DC 16 (a Gargantuan target succeeds automatically). Failure: The target is moved by the beholder up to 30 feet, in whatever direction the beholder picks. The target is Restrained (it has that condition) until the beholder's next turn starts, or sooner if the beholder gains the Incapacitated condition. With this ray, the beholder can also handle objects with fine control, for example working a tool or opening a container or door.
• 7: Sleep Ray Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16 (Construct and Undead targets succeed automatically). Failure: The target gains the Unconscious condition, lasting 1 minute. The condition ends early if the target takes damage or if a creature within 5 feet of it spends an action waking it.
• 8: Petrification Ray Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure by 1 or More: The target gains the Restrained condition; when its next turn ends, if it is still Restrained it repeats the save, and a success ends the effect on it. Failure by 2 or More: The target gains the Petrified condition rather than Restrained.
• 9: Disintegration Ray Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage. Should the target be a nonmagical object or something made of magical force, the part of it inside a 10-foot Cube crumbles to dust. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is disintegrated into dust.
• 10: Death Ray Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target takes 55 (10d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half as much damage. Failure or Success: If the ray brings the target to 0 Hit Points, the target dies.

bonusActions.name: Antimagic Cone
bonusActions.text: The beholder's central eye sends out a wave of antimagic across a 150-foot Cone. Until the beholder's next turn starts, the area functions as the Antimagic Field spell, and it affects the beholder's own Eye Rays as well.

legendary.name: Chomp
legendary.text: The beholder attacks twice with Bite.

legendary.name: Glare
legendary.text: The beholder uses its Eye Rays action.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: A Constitution save (DC equal to 5 plus the damage taken) is made by the zombie whenever damage would take it to 0 Hit Points, unless the damage is Radiant or comes from a Critical Hit. On a success, it drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The zombie uses its Eye Rays action twice.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.text:
The zombie shoots one of the magical rays below at random, aimed at a target within 120 feet of itself that it can see (roll 1d4, rerolling any result for a ray already used earlier in this turn):
• 1: Paralyzing Ray Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target gains the Paralyzed condition. When each of its turns ends, it repeats the save, and a success ends the effect on it. After 1 minute, the target passes the save without rolling.
• 2: Fear Ray Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage and gains the Frightened condition until its next turn ends.
• 3: Enervation Ray Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and gains the Poisoned condition until its next turn ends. The target can't regain Hit Points while Poisoned. Success: Half damage, with no other effect.
• 4: Disintegration Ray Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 27 (5d10) Force damage. Should the target be a nonmagical object or something made of magical force, the part of it inside a 10-foot Cube crumbles to dust. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is disintegrated into dust.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.text: The berserker makes attack rolls and saving throws with Advantage while it is Bloodied.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The berserker makes three attacks, each using Greataxe or Javelin as it chooses.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage, plus 10 (3d6) Thunder damage dealt either to the target or to a different creature within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. The target's Speed also drops by 5 feet until the berserker's next turn begins.

bonusActions.name: Frenzied Rush
bonusActions.text: Every ally within 30 feet of the berserker may use a Reaction to move up to half its own Speed, provoking no Opportunity Attacks. The berserker itself likewise moves up to half its Speed with no Opportunity Attacks provoked.

traits.name: Astral Implosion
traits.text: When the blob drops to 0 Hit Points, it collapses inward, throwing every creature and object it has engulfed into the Astral Sea. The blob disappears and coats everything within 600 feet of where it was in slime. After 1d20 years it re-forms on a world of the Material Plane picked at random.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.text: When the blob fails a save, it may choose instead to succeed.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The blob has Advantage on any save against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The blob uses Engulf and makes two Pseudopod attacks, and it may swap one of those attacks for Restraining Glob.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 30 ft. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) Force damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text:
The blob travels up to its Speed and is able to pass through the spaces of creatures and objects that are Huge or smaller. Strength Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature or object into whose space the blob moves for the first time on this move. Failure: The target is engulfed, getting Total Cover against attacks and effects originating outside the blob and traveling with the blob whenever it moves. A nonmagical object is destroyed once it has been engulfed for 1 minute.
An engulfed creature suffocates and has the Restrained condition. It takes 21 (6d6) Force damage when each of its turns starts and repeats the save when each of its turns ends. If an engulfed creature is brought to 0 Hit Points, it dissolves into ash that is expelled into the Astral Sea. Success: The target gets free and moves into the closest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Restraining Glob
actions.text: The blob hurls a gob of slime at one creature of Large size or smaller that it can see within 600 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23, the creature targeted. Failure: 18 (3d6 + 8) Acid damage. The glob pulls the target 60 feet in a straight line toward the blob. The target also gains the Restrained condition, which lasts until its next turn ends; the glob then dissolves without harm. Success: Half damage, with no other effect.

legendary.name: Decay
legendary.text: Each creature the blob has engulfed takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. The blob can't use this action again before its next turn starts.

legendary.name: Grasping Glob
legendary.text: The blob uses Restraining Glob, and cannot take this action again until its next turn starts.

legendary.name: Lashing Goop
legendary.text: The blob makes a single Pseudopod attack.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The slaad has Advantage on any save against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: While it has 1 Hit Point or more, the slaad recovers 10 Hit Points when each of its turns begins.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The slaad attacks three times with Mutating Claw.

actions.name: Mutating Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. A Humanoid target that isn't already cursed by a slaad also faces the effect below. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target is cursed. It can't regain Hit Points, and every 24 hours its Hit Point maximum drops by 10 (3d6); a Long Rest does not restore the lost maximum. Should that curse take the Hit Point maximum of its victim to 0, it ends, and the victim, rather than dying, immediately turns into a Red Slaad, or into a Green Slaad if it is able to cast level 3 or higher spells. Only the Wish spell can undo this transformation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The naga makes two Bite attacks, and may substitute Serpentine Gaze for any of them.

In place of ordinary burning damage, it takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage when each of its turns begins, and each time it takes that burning damage it gains 1 Exhaustion level. Success: Only half damage.

bonusActions.name: Blazing Movement
bonusActions.text: The salamander travels up to its Speed and provokes no Opportunity Attacks while doing so. Flames fill a 5-foot Emanation that starts at the salamander throughout this movement. Any creature whose space the Emanation enters takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage, though no creature takes it more than once per turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage applies to the satyr's saves versus spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The satyr attacks three times with Prance.

actions.name: Prance
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target gains the Charmed condition until the satyr's next turn begins.

actions.name: Fey Melody (Recharge 4–6)
actions.text:
The satyr plays an enchanting or terrifying tune. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, every enemy within a 60-foot Emanation that starts at the satyr. Failure: The song's effect lands on the target:
• Charming The target is Charmed for 1 minute, and during that time it is also Incapacitated, spending every bit of its movement on dancing in place. Taking any damage ends the effect on it.
• Frightening The target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage and gains the Frightened condition for 1 minute. The condition ends on it if its turn finishes while it is out of the satyr's line of sight.

actions.name: Fearsome Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage, and the target gains the Frightened condition through the end of the scarecrow's following turn.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, a single creature that the scarecrow sees within 30 feet. Failure: The target gains the Frightened condition through the end of the scarecrow's following turn, and for as long as it is Frightened it also has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The scout attacks twice, mixing Shortsword and Longbow as desired.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, plus 10 (3d6) Piercing damage when the attack roll had Advantage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage, plus 10 (3d6) Piercing damage when the attack roll had Advantage.

bonusActions.name: Aim
bonusActions.text: For the rest of this turn, the scout's next attack roll is made with Advantage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.text: Trigger: An attack roll hits the scout. Response: Damage the scout would take from that attack is cut in half, rounding down.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: Should the demon die anywhere other than the Abyss, its body melts into ichor and it immediately takes a new one, returning somewhere in the Abyss with all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: Other creatures and objects count as Difficult Terrain for the demon, and it can pass through them. If its turn finishes while it is within an object, it takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Ability checks and attack rolls are made by the demon with Disadvantage whenever it is in Bright Light.

actions.name: Umbral Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) Psychic damage.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.text: The demon takes the Hide action when it is in Dim Light or Darkness.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: When the dragon fails a saving throw, it may instead succeed.

traits.name: Living Shadow
traits.text: In Dim Light or Darkness, the dragon is Resistant to every damage type except Force, Psychic, and Radiant.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: Ability checks and attack rolls are made by the dragon with Disadvantage whenever it is in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon attacks three times with Rend.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Shadow Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, every creature within a 60-foot Cone. Failure: The target takes 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage. Success: The target takes half of that. Failure or Success: Any Humanoid whose Hit Points drop to 0 from this damage dies, and a Shadow emerges from its corpse. That Shadow obeys the dragon and uses the dragon's Initiative count, but takes its turn right after the dragon's.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.text: The dragon takes the Hide action when it is in Dim Light or Darkness.

legendary.name: Pounce
legendary.text: The dragon travels up to half its Speed and attacks once with Rend.

legendary.name: Veil of Shadow
legendary.text: The dragon uses Shadow Stealth, and a creature it picks that it sees within 10 feet of itself takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. This action is unavailable to the dragon again until its next turn begins.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage applies to the slaad's saves versus spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: The mephit blows up upon dying. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, every creature within a 5-foot Emanation that starts at the mephit. Failure: The target gains the Poisoned condition through the end of its following turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Cinder Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, a single creature that the mephit sees within 15 feet. Failure: The target gains the Blinded condition through the end of the mephit's following turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The spectator uses Eye Rays two times.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.text:
A target the spectator sees within 90 feet of itself is struck by one magical ray picked at random (roll 1d4, and roll again if the spectator already used that ray this turn):
• 1: Confusion Ray Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target takes 5 (2d4) Psychic damage and is unable to take Reactions through the end of its following turn. During that next turn it cannot move, and its action goes to a melee or ranged attack against a creature in range chosen at random. With no possible attack, it does nothing that turn.
• 2: Paralyzing Ray Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target gains the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save when each of its turns ends, ending the condition on a success. After 1 minute the save succeeds automatically.
• 3: Fear Ray Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target takes 5 (2d4) Psychic damage and gains the Frightened condition through the end of its following turn.
• 4: Wounding Ray Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target takes 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Spell Reflection
reactions.text: Trigger: The spectator passes a save versus a spell, or an attack roll made with a spell misses the spectator. Response: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, a single creature that the spectator sees within 120 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Force damage.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.text: Magic cannot watch the sphinx from afar or read its thoughts unless the sphinx allows it. Wisdom (Insight) checks to work out its intentions or honesty are made with Disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage applies to the sphinx's saves versus spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The sphinx attacks three times with Claw. One of those attacks can be swapped for a use of Curse of the Riddle.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Curse of the Riddle
actions.text: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15, a single creature that the sphinx sees within 60 feet. Failure: The target takes 21 (6d6) Psychic damage and is cursed with a riddle. While under the curse, it makes ability checks and attack rolls with Disadvantage. Also, whenever it takes the Magic action, it must pass a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or lose that action. On its turn, the cursed target can use the Study action for a DC 15 Intelligence check; passing it solves the riddle and lifts the curse. If the sphinx curses a different target, the earlier curse ends.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
The sphinx can cast any one of these spells without Material components, with Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At Will: Detect Magic, Identify, Prestidigitation
1/Day Each: Locate Object, Remove Curse

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: Leaving an enemy's reach by flying doesn't trigger Opportunity Attacks from the devil.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Saving throws the devil makes against any spell or other magical effect are made with Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil attacks twice, choosing between Infernal Fork and Tail Spine for each attack.

actions.name: Infernal Fork
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Tail Spine
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 20/80 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The spy performs three attacks, each one either Rapier or Hand Crossbow.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

actions.name: Smoke Bomb (1/Day)
actions.text: The spy hurls a bomb at a point it can see up to 30 feet away from itself. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, every creature inside a Sphere of 20-foot radius whose center is that point. Failure: 28 (8d6) Poison damage. The target also gains the Blinded condition, lasting through the end of that spy's following turn. Success: Half as much damage.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.text: The spy takes either the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Fetid Aura
traits.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature that begins its turn inside a 10-foot Emanation extending from the swarm. Failure: Until the start of its next turn, the target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned this way, on its turn the target can take an action or a Bonus Action but not both, and it can't take Reactions.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can share a space with another creature, and a creature can share the swarm's space. It can squeeze through any gap wide enough for a Small creature. The swarm cannot regain Hit Points, nor can it gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The swarm attacks twice with Rend.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Slashing damage. If the swarm is Bloodied, the damage is instead 9 (3d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can share a space with another creature, and a creature can share the swarm's space. It can squeeze through any gap wide enough for a Medium creature. The swarm cannot regain Hit Points, nor can it gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Bites
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Necrotic damage. If the swarm is Bloodied, the damage is instead 7 (2d4 + 2) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Hellish Restoration
traits.text: Should the swarm die in the Nine Hells, it returns after 1d10 days with all its Hit Points, unless a creature affected by the Bless spell kills it or Holy Water is sprinkled on its remains.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can share a space with another creature, and a creature can share the swarm's space. It can squeeze through any gap wide enough for a Medium creature. The swarm cannot regain Hit Points, nor can it gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The swarm attacks twice with Vile Slime.

actions.name: Vile Slime
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage. If the swarm is Bloodied, the damage is instead 9 (2d6 + 2) Poison damage.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can share a space with another creature, and a creature can share the swarm's space. It can squeeze through any gap wide enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm cannot regain Hit Points, nor can it gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Swarm of Proboscises
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the swarm is Bloodied, it deals 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage instead. A target of Medium size or smaller that occupies the swarm's space also has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). For as long as the grapple lasts, the target suffers 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage when each of its turns ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The thri-kreen attacks twice, each attack being Gythka or Chatkcha.

actions.name: Gythka
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Chatkcha
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Leap
bonusActions.text: The thri-kreen spends 5 feet of movement to leap a distance of up to 15 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The thri-kreen attacks three times with Psionic Lance.

actions.name: Psionic Lance
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Psychic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
Using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15), the thri-kreen casts one of the spells below without spell components:
At Will: Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible)
1/Day Each: Detect Thoughts, Sending, Synaptic Static

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The blight attacks twice with Branch and also uses Grasping Root.

actions.name: Branch
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grasping Root
actions.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature of Large size or smaller that the blight can see in a range of 15 feet. Failure: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16), held by one of six roots, and is dragged up to 10 feet in a straight line toward the blight. While the grapple lasts, 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage is dealt to the target whenever one of its turns begins.

bonusActions.name: Gnash
bonusActions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature that the blight is grappling. Failure: 19 (3d8 + 6) Piercing damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature except troglodytes that begins its turn inside a 5-foot Emanation around the troglodyte. Failure: The Poisoned condition is applied to the target and ends when its next turn starts. Success: The target has immunity to every troglodyte's Stench for 1 hour.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: In sunlight, the troglodyte makes attack rolls and ability checks with Disadvantage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: When the blight attacks a creature, it has Advantage on the attack roll provided an ally of the blight that lacks the Incapacitated condition stands within 5 feet of that creature.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: If the ultroloth is killed anywhere but Gehenna, its body melts into ichor, and it instantly takes a new body, coming back at full Hit Points in some location in Gehenna.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Saving throws the ultroloth makes against any spell or other magical effect are made with Advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ultroloth makes two Mercurial Whip attacks and uses Hypnotic Gaze.

actions.name: Mercurial Whip
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) Force damage. The ultroloth can also teleport the target to a vacant space of its choice, up to 10 feet away, that it can see and that is not in the air.

actions.name: Hypnotic Gaze
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature within a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and also has the Stunned condition, lasting until the ultroloth's next turn starts. Success: For 24 hours, the target is immune to the Hypnotic Gaze of this ultroloth.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text:
Using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17), the ultroloth casts one spell from the list below, needing no Material components:
At Will: Alter Self, Clairvoyance, Detect Magic
1/Day Each: Dimension Door, Fireball (level 5 version), Wall of Fire

spellcasting.name: Fiendish Guile (Recharge 4–6)
spellcasting.text:
The ultroloth casts one of these spells: Suggestion, Misty Step, Invisibility (self only), or Dispel Magic. No Material components are needed, and the spellcasting ability is the same as for Spellcasting.
4/Recharge: Dispel Magic, Invisibility, Misty Step, Suggestion

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.text: The umber hulk can tunnel through solid rock while moving at half its Burrow Speed, leaving behind a tunnel 10 feet in diameter.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The umber hulk attacks three times with Rend.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Confusing Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
bonusActions.text:
Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature within a 30-foot Cone. Failure: Reactions are denied to the target until the umber hulk's next turn begins. During its own next turn, the target rolls 1d8 to decide what it does:
• 1-4 The target stays idle and does nothing.
• 5-6 No action or Bonus Action is available to the target, which instead uses its whole movement to go in a random direction.
• 7-8 If it can make a melee attack, the target uses it against a random creature within its reach; otherwise it does nothing.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.text: If the vampire starts its turn in sunlight, it takes 10 Radiant damage. Disadvantage applies to its ability checks and attack rolls whenever it is in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vampire attacks once with Bite and once with Shadow Strike.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by the Necrotic damage it took, and the vampire regains that many Hit Points.

actions.name: Shadow Strike
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Cold damage.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.text: The vampire takes the Hide action; this requires it to be in Dim Light or Darkness.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: When the vampire fails a saving throw, it may opt to succeed on it.

traits.name: Shadow Escape
traits.text: Whenever the vampire is reduced to 0 Hit Points away from its resting place, it teleports into that resting place, but not if it is in running water or sunlight, and if teleporting is impossible it is destroyed. After arriving in its resting place, it spends 1 hour with the Paralyzed condition, then regains 1 Hit Point.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.text:
The vampire is subject to these weaknesses:
• Forbiddance Without an invitation from one of its occupants, the vampire can't enter a residence.
• Running Water Ending its turn in running water deals 20 Acid damage to the vampire.
• Stake to the Heart The vampire has the Paralyzed condition when a Piercing weapon is driven into its heart while it is in its resting place with the Incapacitated condition; this lasts until the weapon is pulled out.
• Sunlight Starting its turn in sunlight deals 20 Radiant damage to the vampire. In sunlight it also suffers Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vampire attacks twice, and each attack can be Grave Strike or Sickening Ray.

actions.name: Grave Strike
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Sickening Ray
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Necrotic damage. The target also has the Poisoned condition, which lasts until the vampire's next turn begins.

bonusActions.name: Sanguine Drain
bonusActions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature, other than a Construct or an Undead, that the vampire can see within 30 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. The Hit Point maximum of the target drops by the damage it took, and the vampire regains that many Hit Points.

legendary.name: Umbral Strike
legendary.text: The vampire travels up to half its Speed and then makes a single attack with either Grave Strike or Sickening Ray.

spellcasting.name: Hunger of Hadar (Recharge 5–6)
spellcasting.text:
Using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18), the vampire casts the level 5 version of Hunger of Hadar with no spell components.
5/Recharge: Hunger of Hadar (level 5 version)

spellcasting.name: Beguile
spellcasting.text: The vampire casts Command without spell components, using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18). This action is unavailable to the vampire again until its next turn starts.

actions.name: Constricting Vine
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. A target of Large size or smaller also has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). For as long as the grapple lasts, the target takes 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage whenever one of its turns starts, and Constricting Vine attacks are unavailable to the blight during that time.

spellcasting.name: Entangling Plants (Recharge 5–6)
spellcasting.text:
The blight casts Entangle, with Constitution as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).
5/Recharge: Entangle

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The necrohulk attacks twice with Rotting Slam.

actions.name: Rotting Slam
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spore Bomb (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a Sphere with a 20-foot radius, centered on any point within 60 feet that the necrohulk can see. Failure: 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage. The target also has the Poisoned condition until the necrohulk's next turn starts, and while Poisoned it can't regain Hit Points. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Absorb Body
bonusActions.text:
Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Small or Medium creature that the necrohulk can see within 5 feet. Failure: Its target gets pulled into the necrohulk's space and grafted onto its body. Only one creature at a time can be grafted to the necrohulk this way.
While grafted, a creature has the Restrained condition and makes Constitution saving throws with Disadvantage, and it travels along whenever the necrohulk moves. A target that dies while grafted has its body destroyed, which gives the necrohulk 10 Hit Points back.
Either the grafted target or some other creature standing within 5 feet of the necrohulk may use an action to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. If that check succeeds, the target is released and lands in a space within 5 feet of the necrohulk that is unoccupied.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The warrior attacks three times, using Greatsword, Longbow, or a mix of the two.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text:
Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) Slashing damage. In addition, the warrior applies one of these effects:
• Sap The target's next attack roll before the warrior's next turn starts is made with Disadvantage.
• Maneuver An ally that can see or hear the warrior may use a Reaction to move up to half its own Speed, and that movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage. The target's Speed is also reduced by 10 feet through the end of its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Tactical Charge
bonusActions.text: Without provoking Opportunity Attacks, the warrior moves in a straight line toward an enemy it can see, covering up to half its Speed.

reactions.name: Counterattack
reactions.text: Trigger: An attack roll hits the warrior. Response: Against that attack, the warrior gains a +4 bonus to AC, which might turn the hit into a miss. If the attack misses, the warrior can respond by attacking the attacker once, using Greatsword or Longbow.

traits.name: Invisible in Water
traits.text: While it is completely submerged in water, the water weird has the Invisible condition.

traits.name: Water Bound
traits.text: The water weird dies when it departs from the water it is bound to, or when that water is destroyed.

actions.name: Surge
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Cold damage. A target of Medium size or smaller is also Restrained for as long as the grapple lasts, in addition to having the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: When the kobold attacks a creature, it has Advantage on the attack roll provided an ally of the kobold that lacks the Incapacitated condition stands within 5 feet of that creature.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: The kobold has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while in sunlight.

actions.name: Dragon-Tooth Blade
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Chromatic Spittle
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) damage, with the kobold choosing the type from Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

traits.name: Fear of Fire
traits.text: After taking Fire damage, the yeti has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls through the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The yeti can use Chilling Gaze and also makes two attacks, each with either Claw or Ice Throw.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Ice Throw
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

actions.name: Chilling Gaze
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 30 feet that the yeti can see. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage. The Paralyzed condition, lasting until the yeti's next turn begins, is also applied, though not to a target with Immunity to Cold damage. Success: The target gains 1 hour of immunity to the Chilling Gaze of every yeti except abominable yetis.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: A yochlol that dies away from the Abyss has its body dissolve, but it immediately forms a new body in the Abyss and revives there with all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Saving throws the yochlol makes against any spell or other magical effect are made with Advantage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: Climbing difficult surfaces, ceilings included, requires no ability check from the yochlol.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: Webs impose no movement restrictions on the yochlol.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The yochlol attacks twice with Caustic Lash. It may also use Spellcasting to cast Dominate Person or Web when available.

actions.name: Caustic Lash
